pr.body:
## Summary
Caps sync retries with a per-client budget so outages no longer cause retry storms.

## Linked issues
Closes #41
Part of #40

## Follow-ups
- Expose the remaining budget as a metric so we can alert before it empties.
- The gateway client has the same unbounded retry loop; not changed here.

commits.messageHeadline: feat(sync): cap retries with a per-client budget
test(sync): cover budget refill with a fake clock

reviewThreads.comment: Should the budget be configurable per environment? -> author: later, tracked in follow-ups
RetryBudgetExceeded loses the last transport error; consider chaining it.

issues.title: Sync clients cause retry storms during outages
Make sync resilient to upstream outages
